intro:
Most `tabularius serve` options can be set in the environment instead of on the
command line, which suits a service definition or a container. A command-line
flag wins over the variable. Secrets (`TABULARIUS_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET`,
`TABULARIUS_LDAP_SEARCH_PASSWORD`, `TABULARIUS_BACKUP_KEY`, `TABULARIUS_ENCRYPTION_KEY`,
`TABULARIUS_SECRETS_KEY`, `TABULARIUS_S3_SECRET_KEY`) are read only from the
environment, never from a flag, so they stay out of process listings; they are
described where the feature is ([README](../README.md), [ADMIN](../ADMIN.md)).

The `docs:check` gate fails when code reads a `TABULARIUS_*` variable or
accepts a serve flag without a metadata entry. The existing docs drift test
also checks variable names across the documentation.

Settings marked "decimal digits only" require whole numbers (for example `512`), not
empty text, signs, exponent or hexadecimal notation, fractions, or numbers beyond
the safe integer range. An error names the setting; conversion memory and the
aggregate upload quota warn and keep their safe defaults. Port `0` still requests
an automatically assigned port.

The existing zero/off semantics and parsers for `TABULARIUS_CONVERT_TIMEOUT`,
`TABULARIUS_MAX_UPLOAD`, `TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_IDLE_HOURS`,
`TABULARIUS_REQUEST_QUEUE`, `TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_ROWS`,
`TABULARIUS_REQUEST_BUDGET_MS`, and `TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL_MIN_MS` are unchanged: zero
retains each setting's documented disabling behavior. Fractional monetary budgets are also unchanged.
clientExampleNote:
- `TABULARIUS_AUTH` is the name an example in [Connect an AI app](connect-ai.md)
  gives to the client-side variable holding the bearer token; it belongs to the
  MCP client's configuration.

TABULARIUS_ACME_DIRECTORY.description: A different certificate authority's directory address, for testing.

TABULARIUS_AI_ACCOUNT_DAILY_TOKENS.description: A cap on tokens per account per day.
TABULARIUS_AI_ACCOUNT_DAILY_TOKENS.accepted: Positive number of tokens; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_AI_DAILY_TOKENS.description: A cap on tokens per day.
TABULARIUS_AI_DAILY_TOKENS.accepted: Positive number of tokens; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_AI_EMBED_KEY.description: API key sent to the configured embedding endpoint when it requires authentication.

TABULARIUS_AI_EMBED_MODEL.description: Model id for text embeddings at the configured endpoint.

TABULARIUS_AI_EMBED_URL.description: Endpoint for text embeddings used by semantic find and related features.
TABULARIUS_AI_EMBED_URL.accepted: ollama, lmstudio, or an embedding endpoint URL

TABULARIUS_AI_EXCLUDE.description: Comma-separated files kept from the assistant and AI apps entirely.

TABULARIUS_AI_FAST_MODEL.description: The model used for simple questions.

TABULARIUS_AI_IMAGE_EMBED.description: `voyage` or `jina`, the service that embeds images for Perform Semantic Find by image (its key is `TABULARIUS_AI_IMAGE_EMBED_KEY`).

TABULARIUS_AI_IMAGE_EMBED_KEY.description: API key for the configured image embedding provider.

TABULARIUS_AI_IMAGE_EMBED_MODEL.description: The model used for Perform Semantic Find by image.

TABULARIUS_AI_KEY_FILE.description: A file holding the Anthropic key, read again when it changes.
TABULARIUS_AI_KEY_FILE.restart: Changing this path needs a restart; edits to the file at that path are reread.

TABULARIUS_AI_MODEL.description: The model used for design work.

TABULARIUS_AI_MONTHLY_BUDGET.description: A stop at about this many US dollars a month.
TABULARIUS_AI_MONTHLY_BUDGET.accepted: Positive US dollar amount, with optional leading $

TABULARIUS_AI_RUN_TOKENS.description: A strict cap on tokens one assistant question may use; a model call that could take it past the cap is not made.

TABULARIUS_AI_WORKSPACE_ID.description: The workspace id for a key not made inside a workspace.

TABULARIUS_ALIAS.description: Internal launcher compatibility switch for the legacy executable name.
TABULARIUS_ALIAS.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_ALLOW_PLAIN_HTTP.description: Lets the server listen beyond this computer over plain HTTP, which it otherwise refuses to do (a proxy or network you control does the HTTPS). Set in the Docker image.
TABULARIUS_ALLOW_PLAIN_HTTP.default: Off: listening beyond this computer needs HTTPS

TABULARIUS_BACKUP_EVERY.description: How often a backup is made (`1d` by default).

TABULARIUS_BACKUP_KEEP.description: How many backups to keep (7 by default).
TABULARIUS_BACKUP_KEEP.accepted: Whole number of 1 or more; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_BACKUP_KEY.description: Passphrase used to encrypt backup sets.

TABULARIUS_BACKUP_S3.description: A `s3://bucket/prefix` address that backups are also copied to.

TABULARIUS_CAPTURE_ONLY.description: Hosted file name prefixes whose outbound effects stay in capture mode.

TABULARIUS_CHROMIUM.description: Chromium executable used by the browser test harness.
TABULARIUS_CHROMIUM.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_CONNECTIONS_PER_ADDRESS.description: Maximum simultaneous transport connections admitted from one address.

TABULARIUS_CONTAINER_TTL.description: Lifetime of a signed container URL.
TABULARIUS_CONTAINER_TTL.accepted: Positive seconds up to 3600, which is also what any other value (0, negative, not a number, longer) gives; a link signed for more than an hour ahead is refused

TABULARIUS_CONVERT_MEMORY.description: Memory budget for an uploaded file conversion worker, in MB. The memory cap cannot be turned off. Zero, empty or invalid input logs one warning and keeps the 2048 MB default.
TABULARIUS_CONVERT_MEMORY.accepted: Positive safe whole number of MB, decimal digits only; 0 or invalid uses 2048

TABULARIUS_CONVERT_TIMEOUT.description: Time budget for a conversion process, in seconds.
TABULARIUS_CONVERT_TIMEOUT.accepted: Nonnegative number of seconds; 0 disables the limit

TABULARIUS_COUNT_SQL.description: Counts the prepared statements a store runs and the rows they change, for measuring (scripts/bulk-scale.ts, docs/performance.md).
TABULARIUS_COUNT_SQL.restart: No server restart; read when a store is opened.

TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT.description: Largest record count one Data API request may ask for.
TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT.accepted: Nonnegative whole number; 0 removes the cap
TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_DRAIN_SECONDS.description: How long a stopping server lets requests that are already running finish before it closes them (1 to 86400, 20 by default; see [Upgrading](upgrading.md), "Stopping and restarting").
TABULARIUS_DRAIN_SECONDS.accepted: Whole seconds from 1 to 86400, decimal digits only

TABULARIUS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Passphrase used to unlock encrypted hosted files. A set-but-empty or whitespace-only value refuses startup; unset it to run without encryption, or give a passphrase. Nonblank passphrases are used unchanged.
TABULARIUS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.accepted: Nonblank passphrase for encrypted hosted files; unset for no encryption

TABULARIUS_FIXTURE_CACHE.description: Where `npm run fixtures` keeps downloaded fixture files between checkouts (`~/.cache/tabularius-fixtures` by default).
TABULARIUS_FIXTURE_CACHE.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_FMS_KEY_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase for the source server certificate key during migration.
TABULARIUS_FMS_KEY_PASSPHRASE.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_FMS_PASSWORD.description: Password supplied to migration or sync commands for the source server.
TABULARIUS_FMS_PASSWORD.restart: Yes for a running server; new CLI invocations read the changed value.

TABULARIUS_FOLDER.description: Hosted folder used when tabularius starts with no command.
TABULARIUS_FOLDER.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_FUZZ_SELFTEST.description: Internal to the fuzz harness (`scripts/fuzz/worker.ts`): `error`, `hang`, `exit` or `oom` makes every input fail that way, to prove the detector end to end. Set by `packages/server/test/fuzz.test.ts`; no manual setting is needed.
TABULARIUS_FUZZ_SELFTEST.restart: No server restart; the fuzz worker reads it when it starts.

TABULARIUS_HOME.description: The folder holding per-user settings (`~/.openhbam` by default): the AI key file, and the service definition's files.
TABULARIUS_HOME.restart: Yes for a running server; new CLI invocations read the changed value.

TABULARIUS_HOST.description: The address to listen on (`127.0.0.1` by default; `0.0.0.0` with `--https name`).

TABULARIUS_HTTPS.description: `name[,name]` for a Let's Encrypt certificate, or `local` for this server's own authority.
TABULARIUS_HTTPS.accepted: local, lan, or comma-separated DNS names

TABULARIUS_HTTPS_EMAIL.description: The contact address given to Let's Encrypt.

TABULARIUS_HTTP_PORT.description: The port that answers the certificate challenge and redirects to https (80 by default).
TABULARIUS_HTTP_PORT.accepted: Port number; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_LDAP_BASE_DN.description: Where in the directory people are looked up.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_BASE_DN.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LDAP_BIND_DN_TEMPLATE.description: The distinguished name a person signs in as, with the user name filled in.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_BIND_DN_TEMPLATE.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LDAP_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE.description: The attribute holding the email address.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LDAP_GROUP_ATTRIBUTE.description: The attribute listing the person's groups.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_GROUP_ATTRIBUTE.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LDAP_NAME.description: The name shown for the directory.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_NAME.default: Hostname of the configured LDAP URL

TABULARIUS_LDAP_SEARCH_DN.description: The account used to find a person before they sign in.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_SEARCH_DN.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LDAP_SEARCH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the configured LDAP search account.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_SEARCH_PASSWORD.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LDAP_USER_ATTRIBUTE.description: The attribute holding the user name.
TABULARIUS_LDAP_USER_ATTRIBUTE.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

TABULARIUS_LIST_FILES_PUBLICLY.description: Whether unsigned callers can see hosted file names.

TABULARIUS_LOG_LIMIT.description: Size at which a server log is rotated.

TABULARIUS_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_ACCOUNT.description: Maximum active Data API sessions per account.
TABULARIUS_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_ACCOUNT.accepted: Nonnegative whole number; 0 removes the cap
TABULARIUS_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_ACCOUNT.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_MAX_SESSION_LOCKS.description: Maximum record locks held by one session in a file.

TABULARIUS_MAX_UPLOAD.description: Largest file accepted by the server upload route, in bytes.
TABULARIUS_MAX_UPLOAD.accepted: Nonnegative bytes; 0 removes the per-file cap

TABULARIUS_MAX_UPLOAD_IN_PROGRESS.description: Combined byte reservation allowed across ongoing uploads and conversions.
TABULARIUS_MAX_UPLOAD_IN_PROGRESS.accepted: Positive safe whole bytes, decimal digits only; 0 or invalid uses the default with a warning

TABULARIUS_MCP_ORIGINS.description: Additional browser origins permitted to call the MCP endpoint.

TABULARIUS_MCP_TOKEN.description: Administrator bearer token for the MCP endpoint.

TABULARIUS_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.description: A private regular file holding the MCP access token.
TABULARIUS_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.accepted: File path (the file must not be readable by other users)

TABULARIUS_MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH.description: The fewest characters a new password may have in a file whose own policy names no minimum, and for the admin console.
TABULARIUS_MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH.accepted: Whole number from 0 to 999 (0 for no minimum)

TABULARIUS_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: The client id registered with the provider.

TABULARIUS_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret for the configured OpenID Connect provider.

TABULARIUS_OIDC_CONFIG.description: A JSON file describing several providers.

TABULARIUS_OIDC_DATA_API_RETURN_URLS.description: Comma-separated addresses the Data API sign-in may return to.

TABULARIUS_OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM.description: The claim that lists the person's groups.

TABULARIUS_OIDC_ISSUER.description: The OpenID Connect provider's issuer address.

TABULARIUS_OIDC_NAME.description: The name shown on the sign-in button.
TABULARIUS_OIDC_NAME.default: Hostname of the configured issuer URL

TABULARIUS_OIDC_TRUST_EMAIL.description: `1`, `true` or `yes` to accept the provider's email address as the account name.

TABULARIUS_OUTBOUND_MAX_TIME_MS.description: Maximum time a script outbound request can spend, in milliseconds.
TABULARIUS_OUTBOUND_MAX_TIME_MS.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_PASSWORD.description: Password supplied to a CLI command that otherwise asks interactively.
TABULARIUS_PASSWORD.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_BUFFERED_ROWS.description: Combined result rows that one SQL connection may hold in portals.
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_BUFFERED_ROWS.accepted: Positive whole number of rows; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_BUFFERED_ROWS.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_ROWS.description: Maximum rows a SQL query may return.
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_ROWS.accepted: Nonnegative whole number of rows; 0 removes the cap
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_ROWS.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_TX_IDLE_MS.description: How long a SQL connection may sit idle inside BEGIN, in milliseconds, before it is rolled back and closed. Only matters with --sql-writes.
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_TX_IDLE_MS.accepted: Nonnegative whole number of milliseconds; 0 for no limit
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_TX_IDLE_MS.restart: No server restart; read when a SQL connection begins a transaction.

TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_TX_MAX_MS.description: The longest a SQL connection may keep one transaction open, however busy it is, in milliseconds. Only matters with --sql-writes.
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_TX_MAX_MS.accepted: Nonnegative whole number of milliseconds; 0 for no limit
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_TX_MAX_MS.restart: No server restart; read when a SQL connection begins a transaction.

TABULARIUS_PROGRESSIVE.description: How often changes are saved as a point you can restore to with `tabularius restore --at`; `off` for never.
TABULARIUS_PROGRESSIVE.accepted: off or an interval such as 5m

TABULARIUS_PROXY_HEADER.description: The header a trusted proxy puts the client address in.

TABULARIUS_PUBLIC_URL.description: Externally reachable base URL advertised by the server.

TABULARIUS_REPLICATION_TOKEN.description: The token a standby presents to the primary.

TABULARIUS_REPLICATION_TOKEN_FILE.description: A private regular file holding the replication token; the primary requires at least 16 characters.
TABULARIUS_REPLICATION_TOKEN_FILE.accepted: File path (the file must not be readable by other users)

TABULARIUS_REQUEST_BUDGET_MS.description: Time one request may hold the server event loop, in milliseconds.

TABULARIUS_REQUEST_LIMIT.description: How many requests each worker runs at once before further ones wait in a queue (32 by default, at least 4). Two of the slots are kept for sign-in and static files. See [Performance](performance.md).
TABULARIUS_REQUEST_LIMIT.accepted: Whole number of 4 or more; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_REQUEST_QUEUE.description: How many requests may wait for a free slot in each worker (64 by default, 0 for none). A request that cannot wait is answered 503 with `Retry-After: 1`. See [Performance](performance.md).

TABULARIUS_S3_ACCESS_KEY.description: Access key id for off-site S3-compatible storage.

TABULARIUS_S3_ENDPOINT.description: An S3-compatible service's address, for other providers than Amazon.

TABULARIUS_S3_REGION.description: The bucket's region (`AWS_REGION` is used when this is not set).

TABULARIUS_S3_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret access key for off-site S3-compatible storage.

TABULARIUS_SECRETS_KEY.description: Passphrase used to seal outside-connection secrets.

TABULARIUS_SHARE_RESULTS.description: Controls in-memory sharing of query results when enabled by the server.
TABULARIUS_SHARE_RESULTS.default: Enabled when result sharing is configured and the file is not encrypted

TABULARIUS_SMTP.description: SMTP account URL used by Send Mail when sending is enabled.

TABULARIUS_SMTP_FILE.description: A file holding the SMTP account for `--send-mail` (`~/.openhbam/smtp` by default); `TABULARIUS_SMTP` holds it directly.

TABULARIUS_SOURCE_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase used to open an encrypted source file from the CLI.
TABULARIUS_SOURCE_PASSPHRASE.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_SQL_PORT.description: The port for the PostgreSQL-compatible SQL connection.
TABULARIUS_SQL_PORT.accepted: Port number from 0 to 65535; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_SQL_WRITES.description: 1 lets the SQL connection run INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE (off by default); needs the SQL port.
TABULARIUS_SQL_WRITES.default: Off: the SQL connection is read-only

TABULARIUS_STATS_INTERVAL.description: How often the server writes statistics log lines.

TABULARIUS_STOP_GRACE_MS.description: How long `tabularius service stop` waits for the server to finish before it ends it (30000 by default).
TABULARIUS_STOP_GRACE_MS.accepted: Positive safe whole milliseconds, decimal digits only

TABULARIUS_SYNC_HOSTS.description: Allowed source server hosts for the sync console.
TABULARIUS_SYNC_HOSTS.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_SYNC_SECRETS.description: Directory containing sync credentials for hosted files.
TABULARIUS_SYNC_SECRETS.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_TEST_CHILD_MARKER.description: Internal to `scripts/test-cross-file-isolation.ts`: the runner sets a temporary marker path for its forbidden-command stubs. A stub writes the marker if invoked, causing the audit to fail. No manual setting is needed.
TABULARIUS_TEST_CHILD_MARKER.restart: No server restart; a new command reads it on invocation.

TABULARIUS_TEST_SMTP.description: The SMTP account (`smtps://user:pass@host:465`) that `--test-outbound --mail-redirect` sends its one copy through.

TABULARIUS_TEST_SMTP_FILE.description: A file holding that account (`~/.openhbam/test-smtp` by default).

TABULARIUS_THUMBNAILS.description: Selects built-in thumbnail tools instead of available system tools.

TABULARIUS_TOKEN_DEFAULT_DAYS.description: Days an API or AI-app token lives when no lifetime is asked for (calendar feed addresses keep their own default).
TABULARIUS_TOKEN_DEFAULT_DAYS.accepted: Whole or decimal number of days above 0 and up to 3650; anything else keeps 90
TABULARIUS_TOKEN_DEFAULT_DAYS.restart: No server restart; read when a token is made.

TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL.description: Enables SQL statement tracing to stderr only for explicit true values. Unrecognized values disable tracing and log one warning per process naming the setting.
TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL.accepted: 1, true, yes, on enable; empty, 0, false, no, off disable (case-insensitive)
TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL_MIN_MS.description: With `TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL` set, logs only statements that took this many milliseconds or more.
TABULARIUS_TRACE_SQL_MIN_MS.restart: Yes; restart the server after changing its environment.

TABULARIUS_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Address ranges allowed to supply the configured proxy header.
TABULARIUS_TRUSTED_PROXIES.accepted: Comma-separated IP addresses or CIDR ranges

TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_IDLE_HOURS.description: How many hours an upload in pieces (`container-uploads`) may receive nothing before it is dropped (24 by default; `0` keeps them until the server restarts).
TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_IDLE_HOURS.accepted: nonnegative number; 0 keeps uploads until restart

TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_TMP.description: The folder files wait in while they arrive in a container upload (the system's temporary folder by default). It needs room for the biggest files being uploaded at once.

TABULARIUS_VISUAL_UPDATE.description: Internal to `npm run test:visual -- --update`: tells the visual regression test to write changed screenshot baselines. No manual setting is needed.

TABULARIUS_WARM_HEAP_MB.description: Memory budget for the background warming worker, in MB.
TABULARIUS_WARM_HEAP_MB.accepted: Positive safe whole MB, decimal digits only; values below 256 use 256

TABULARIUS_WORKERS.description: The number of worker processes, or `auto` for one per CPU core.
TABULARIUS_WORKERS.accepted: auto or a positive whole number; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_PARAM_BYTES.description: Total bound parameter bytes that one SQL connection's portals may hold.
TABULARIUS_PGWIRE_MAX_PARAM_BYTES.accepted: Positive whole number of bytes; 0 or an invalid value keeps the default

--accept-partial-standby.default: Off: a failover from an unfinished copy is refused

--ai-account-daily-tokens.accepted: Positive number of tokens; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--ai-daily-tokens.accepted: Positive number of tokens; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--ai-embed-url.accepted: ollama, lmstudio, or an embedding endpoint URL

--ai-monthly-budget.accepted: Positive US dollar amount, with optional leading $

--allow-plain-http.default: Off: listening beyond this computer needs HTTPS

--backup-every.accepted: off or an interval such as 1d

--http-port.accepted: Port from 0 to 65535; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--keep.accepted: Whole number of 1 or more; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--keep-api-tokens-on-takeover.default: Off: API tokens end when a standby takes over

--ldap-base-dn.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

--ldap-bind-dn-template.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

--ldap-email-attribute.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

--ldap-group-attribute.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

--ldap-name.default: Hostname of the configured LDAP URL

--ldap-search-dn.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

--ldap-user-attribute.accepted: LDAP distinguished name, template, attribute, or password as named by the variable

--list-files-publicly.accepted: Switch; present makes file names public

--mcp-token-file.accepted: File path (a private regular file holding the token)

--oidc-name.default: Hostname of the configured issuer URL

--port.accepted: Port number from 0 to 65535; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--replication-token-file.accepted: File path (a private regular file holding the token)

--sql-port.accepted: Port from 0 to 65535; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--sql-writes.default: Off: the SQL connection is read-only

--trusted-proxies.accepted: Comma-separated IP addresses or CIDR ranges

--workers.accepted: Whole number from 1 to 64, or auto; decimal digits only for numbers, within the safe integer range

--open.accepted: Switch; present opens the admin welcome page

audit.exitCodes: 0 on success; 1 on error; 2 when unprotected.

check-solution.exitCodes: 0 on success; 1 on error; 2 when findings are present.
